dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual linear narrowing of the body mass from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle, forming an elongated teardrop geometry.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Slight asymmetrical outward curvature on the left lateral margin mid-body; the right lateral margin exhibits a more uniform, straighter edge.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with high median pixel intensity across the entire visible dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Minimal; light grey-pixel clustering is restricted to the extreme anterior tip of the rostrum area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the grey anterior tip and the primary depigmented white dorsal canvas.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Small, dark, high-contrast focal mark located on the right side of the posterior dorsal ridge.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: The dorsal ridge is visible as a raised, shadow-casting linear feature along the posterior midline; no unnatural traumatic indentations observed.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small dark punctate mark on the right posterior flank near the dorsal ridge may represent a localized epidermal lesion.
other_distinctive_markers: The blowhole is visible as a high-contrast, dark circular aperture on the anterior dorsal midline.
